author: deepseek-3.2
brief: Phase: code review. Role of the person asking: reviewer. Repo kind: a Python 3.12 community forum backend on http.server (users, posts, a storage module, image helpers in pure Python, tests, docs). The PR adds profile picture upload. Plant: the stored file name is built from the client's file name, so ../ escapes the upload folder; there is no size limit though the config defines one; the type check trusts the client's Content-Type; the temp file is not removed on the error path; the public URL returned uses the user's email in the path; the old picture is never deleted and the docs promise it is. Add one decoy.
